import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_5.csv')
# robust z-score per group using median/MAD
def mad_z(x):
    med = x.median()
    mad = (x - med).abs().median()
    return (x - med) / (1.4826 * mad)
df['z'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform(mad_z)
top = df.reindex(df['z'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_5.csv')
res=[]
for (a,s), grp in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    x = grp['BilledCost']
    med=x.median(); mad=(x-med).abs().median()
    z=(x-med)/(1.4826*mad)
    res.append((z.abs().max(), a, s, grp.loc[z.abs().idxmax(),'ChargePeriodStart'], x.max()))
res.sort(reverse=True)
for r in res: print(r)
